qrender-edit: Label of the action that opens a statement on Wikidata to edit it.
qrender-add-label: Label of the action that opens Wikidata to add a label in the reader's language, on a label that is shown in another language.
qrender-credit: Label of the button that shows the author and the licence of a picture.
qrender-close: Label of the button that closes a dialog.
qrender-bce:
A year before the common era. Parameters:
* $1 - the year, without a sign (300 for 300 BCE).
qrender-some-value: Shown for a statement whose value is "unknown value" on Wikidata.
qrender-age:
The age of a person at death, after the date of death. Parameters:
* $1 - the number of years.
qrender-language: The label of the choice of language in the names of an item.
qrender-add-value: The label of the action to add a name in the chosen language, on a name that is shown in another language (a fallback).
qrender-earlier: A mark after the label of a media property: its files that ended, before the current one (the earlier flags of a country). It is followed by the years they cover.
qrender-other-value: A mark on a measurement of a year that has another value, the preferred one (from another source). It is in the table and the tooltip of a chart.
qrender-footer:
The note at the end of a page. Parameters:
* $1 - a link to the item on Wikidata, with its id as text.
* $2 - the versions of the composition, the view and the design system.
